integrity: The 1296 labeled profiles are exhaustively checked. Canonical-orbit enumeration and a separate Burnside fixed-point computation agree exactly, while stability is independently implemented by rank and prefix tests.
scientific_limitations: The result is a complete finite classification for four strict roommate agents only; it gives no asymptotic or higher-cardinality orbit formula.
title: Stability-stratified isomorphism census for four-person stable roommates
